name: Thunderfury, Blessed Blade of the Windseeker
note: The iconic tank sword. Its thunderfury proc is the reason every raid wants one — threat and mitigation in a single weapon.

name: Sulfuras, Hand of Ragnaros
note: The classic two-hander flex. Whoever wields it owns the raid's melee spotlight.

name: Arcanite Reaper
note: Affordable warrior leveling weapon near 60. Still the best 'done by the time you hit the level cap' craft.

name: Dal'Rend's Sacred Charge
note: Half of the Dal'Rend set. Strong pre-raid choice for warriors and rogues alike.

name: Dal'Rend's Tribal Guardian
note: The off-hand half of the set. Together they define the Dal'Rend two-sword look.

name: Vis'kag the Bloodletter
note: A fast sword with a bleed proc — a pre-raid staple for melee DPS.

name: Brutality Blade
note: High-end rogue and warrior DPS sword. When it drops, the loot drama starts.

name: Perdition's Blade
note: Dagger rogue priority. The bleed proc adds real damage on long fights.

name: Azuresong Mageblade
note: Caster weapon with strong spell power for its slot. A common first raid upgrade for mages and warlocks.

name: Robe of the Archmage
note: Crafted caster chest and often the first 'real' epic a spellcaster owns.

name: Nightfall
note: A group-support weapon: its proc increases spell damage taken by the target. One per raid can be huge.

name: Hand of Justice
note: Melee trinket that procs extra attacks. Worth more than its rarity suggests.

name: Blackhand's Breadth
note: Crit trinket from the UBRS quest line. A pre-raid checklist item for most DPS.

name: Royal Seal of Eldre'Thalas
note: Caster trinket from the Dire Maul quest chain. Useful well into early raiding.

name: Ironfoe
note: Extra-attack proc mace and a famous BRD chase item. Its drop rate is the punchline.

name: Crown of Destruction
note: Caster helm with fire-damage synergy, ideal for early fire spec raiders.

name: Quel'Serrar
note: Tanking sword from the forging quest. Requires a raid drop and a group willing to run the chain.

name: Lionheart Helm
note: Crit-focused plate helm and a pre-raid best-in-slot for warriors.

name: Devilsaur Gauntlets
note: Hit and crit leather gloves from the Devilsaur set. Feral druids and rogues both want them.

name: Choker of the Fire Lord
note: Spell power neck and an early caster upgrade that lasts through the first raid tier.

name: Cape of the Black Baron
note: Baron Rivendare's cloak; strong on melee and casters alike.

name: Whitemane's Chapeau
note: Caster hat from High Inquisitor Whitemane; a low-level standout.

name: Robe of the Void
note: Warlock tailoring chest built around shadow damage.

name: Draconian Deflector
note: Tank shield from UBRS; stamina and block value.

name: Onyxia Tooth Pendant
note: Hit and crit neck from Onyxia; a melee upgrade that lasts.

name: Band of Accuria
note: Hit ring from Molten Core; one of the best early raid pickups.

name: Ashkandi, Greatsword of the Brotherhood
note: Nefarian's two-hander. A statement weapon for warriors and paladins.

name: Claw of Chromaggus
note: Fast dagger with spell-power synergy from Chromaggus.

name: Staff of the Shadow Flame
note: Caster staff from Nefarian; a top pre-AQ spell damage weapon.

name: Neltharion's Tear
note: Spell hit and damage trinket from Nefarian.

name: Drake Fang Talisman
note: Hit and attack power trinket; melee priority from BWL.

name: Rhok'delar, Longbow of the Ancient Keepers
note: Reward from the hunter epic quest chain; the classic pre-raid bow.

name: Ashjre'thul, Crossbow of Smiting
note: Chromaggus crossbow; the hunter upgrade after Rhok'delar.

name: Blackcrow
note: UBRS crossbow; a realistic hunter upgrade while farming Rhok'delar.

name: Rejuvenating Gem
note: Healer trinket from BWL with strong mana regeneration.
